title: Worker member shutdown and string cleanup
summary: Recover 0x48d800 thiscall cleanup as a genuine member method with explicit 32-bit layout and original IAT bindings. Preserve wait/stop/reset/signal/join order, unsigned SSO capacity threshold, string reset, vtable transitions and thread close. Constructor and enclosing destructor corroborate fields.
test_description: 360 direct original-versus-C++ cases: nine capacities including 15/16 and unsigned extremes, five handle/API result patterns, eight initial byte patterns. Compare ordered callback arguments and full object snapshots at each call plus final 96-byte storage, check untouched fields/tail, infinite wait arguments, final invariants and FS head restoration. Exact 4096-byte oracle IAT fixture binds only the five used imports.
known_limits: Class identity and fields beyond the partial layout remain unresolved.
Controlled callbacks validate call ordering and memory effects, not Windows synchronization, heap freeing, OS failure internals or concurrent worker behavior.
Normal return paths only; exception propagation/unwinding is not exercised.
Readable source is behavior recovery; no byte matching claim.
Optional local MSVC helper is unavailable; GCC C++11 O2 and required C++17 O0 builds both pass the differential suite. Native Windows compilation is delegated to trusted validation.
